thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] SEV2 - high error rate for tenant aurum-001 in aurum-prod (VPC dedicated). 40% 5xx, latency spike >5s. Incident INC-2026-0413-aurum. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/aurum/INC-2026-0413
oncall-frontend: picking up, looking at dashboards now
oncall-frontend: @sre-elena can you join? I see kernel_launch_failed and OOM-ish traces on several workers in ded-aurum-01
sre-elena: on it, grabbing logs and node health. likely memory fragmentation + kernel mismatch on quant paths
oncall-backend: I see KV cache thrash and evictions correlated with errors. model v2.4-quant path hitting unsupported kernel on this hw profile. recommend safe fallback to v2.3 safe variant
ae-james: looping customer in: Aurum Ops — we have a SEV2 and are investigating. possible temporary pin to a stable model variant. will confirm ETA in 10m
pm-ravi: can we scope customer impact (endpoints, %traffic, business impact)?
sre-elena: affected: /v1/generate for aurum-001, ~450 rps, 35% 5xx over last 10m. top errors: "kernel_launch_failed", "insufficient_shared_mem". no full tenant eviction yet but increased latency/timeouts
oncall-frontend: nodes ded-aurum-01a and 01c show high GPU fragmentation, memory alloc failures in driver logs
sre-elena: mitigation plan: 1) pin aurum tenant to safe variant redwood/llama-2-7b-safe@v2.3 2) route 10% to canary on alt pool alt-aurum-canary 3) controlled drain+restart of affected workers 4) monitor metrics and rollback if regress
oncall-backend: admin pin command (use with admin token):
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/admin/tenants/aurum-001/pin \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/llama-2-7b-safe","version":"v2.3","reason":"runbook fallback - kernel failures"}'
```
nae-james: sent message to customer: "We will pin you to v2.3 and run a 10% canary, expect latency improvements within 5-10m. We'll post updates here."
customer-ops-alice: Confirmed. Please proceed. We are throttling client traffic while you remediate
sre-elena: executing pin now
sre-elena: pin applied and routing rule created. canary at 10% to alt-aurum-canary started
oncall-frontend: canary healthy so far — 0 5xx last 2m, latency down ~800ms vs baseline
pm-ravi: good — any expected billing delta from canary/pin? will flag to finance if sustained
ae-james: customer ok with delta for stability
sre-elena: starting controlled drain+restart of ded-aurum-01 nodes, one at a time
oncall-backend: adding fallback policy to tenant config:
PATCH /admin/tenants/aurum-001/config 
{ "fallback_policy": "pin_on_failure", "safe_variant": "redwood/llama-2-7b-safe@v2.3" }
sre-elena: restarts complete, cluster stabilized. 5xx dropped to ~1.2%. monitoring window recommended: 30m
incident-bot: INC-2026-0413-aurum: Pager acknowledged by oncall-frontend at 5070024685. Mitigation in progress
sre-elena: handing off monitoring to @oncall-backend for next 2h. escalate if >2% 5xx or canary shows regression
oncall-backend: ack, will watch dashboards and logs. will kick off postmortem if regression occurs
ae-james: scheduling customer follow-up call in 45m to review incident and plan for config changes
customer-ops-alice: thanks everyone, appreciate the fast response
sre-elena: next steps for postmortem: doc kernel selection failure scenario, add guard to quantized kernel selection, adjust KV cache tuning for aurum traffic pattern, and add a permanent tenant fallback config
oncall-frontend: moving pager to monitoring state, will close if steady for 30m
incident-bot: INC-2026-0413-aurum: Severity reduced to P1. Auto-close timer started.
